feat(docs): rich-markup-plugins runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.7iv)

One file, main.ts, printing through new Console(); the entry for the card
and npm run markup-plugins. Revamped: each sample's markup prints dim above
what it draws, samples fit the card's 75 columns, handlers in the
docs/markup-tags.md idiom. app.ts/index.ts/wire.ts deleted.

fix(docs): docs:dev serves pages again — a docs bundle hands NODE_ENV back (rich-example-card-b5rz.b5s) (#362)

* fix(docs): docs:dev serves pages again — a docs bundle hands NODE_ENV back (rich-example-card-b5rz.b5s)

Vite's in-process `build` sets NODE_ENV to "production" when it is unset.
`[demo].paths.ts` bundles the live library (via `demoCard`) while VitePress
resolves its config, before the dev server resolves its own, so `docs:dev`
came up with DEV false and every page threw `__VP_HASH_MAP__ is not
defined`. `bundle` now restores the host's value, or its absence, when the
last overlapping bundle ends.

* fix(docs): the NODE_ENV a bundle restores is counted per process, not per module copy (rich-example-card-b5rz.b5s)

VitePress inlines example-runner.ts into its config and again into
[demo].paths.ts; a per-copy in-flight count let one copy put back the
"production" another copy's bundle wrote. The test's restore no longer
writes the string "undefined", and a failing bundle and two copies are covered.
